To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a clinically relevant gene signature for TNBC was identified that includes a ratio of high expression of B-cell metagene and low expression of IL-8 metagene; (2) the gene expression signature is associated with survival in TNBC and is the only significant predictor of survival when included with clinicopathological factors in multivariate analysis; and (3) the gene signature identifies 32% of patients with good survival.
